name: OHLC Sum
description: This keyword can be used for all series based technical indicator's. It will fetch the value of a particular candle in series for two different instruments and sum it up.  You can thus check the combined premium of two strikes.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword can be used for all series based technical indicator's. It will fetch the value of a particular candle in series for two different instruments and sum it up.  You can thus check the combined premium of two strikes.

This keyword is nested within most series or technical indicators. In order to OHLC sum, you need to select position keyword and then select the series/indictor for which you need to find the spread between the two instruments. Post that click on the indicator to select keyword 'OHLC Sum'.

![Example](./images/img-1632483076.png)

![Example](./images/img-1632139142.png)

As shown in the above example, you can find the previous 5 minute close of the current week ATM CE and PE for the weekly option for Nifty 50 and sum it up.
